description_en: Queries the information about a resource group for an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 调用DescribeDBResourceGroup接口查询集群的资源组信息
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-db-resource-group --db-cluster-id am-bp1ub9grke10000 --group-name USER_DEFAULT --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBResourceGroup

parameters.help_en:
